infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Glideboard uses the camera so you can take a profile photo.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Glideboard accesses your photos so you can choose a profile picture.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Glideboard uses the microphone to count your reps out loud during voice workouts.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: Glideboard uses motion sensors to automatically count your reps as you exercise.
